design_philosophy.vibe: Adventurous, warm, premium — like a high-end travel magazine meets Skyscanner precision.
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss editorial typography + high-velocity travel marketplace UX + passport tactile details.
Tactile Authenticity: Ticket-stub cards with perforated edge cuts, dashed dividers, mint passport-stamp verified badges.
Visual Hierarchy & Breathing Room: Generous 2x spacing, 20-28px rounded containers, subtle grain textures, soft layered shadows.
Motion with Weight: Framer-motion staggered reveals, card tilt on hover, heart burst animation, flight path route arcs, respect prefers-reduced-motion.

compact_search_bar.description: Glassmorphic hero search widget with 5 inputs: Where (destination), When (dates/month), Travelling As (Solo/Couple/Group size), Budget (range slider/chips), Search button
compact_search_bar.container_class: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#0B1F2A]/90 p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl border border-white/50 dark:border-white/10 shadow-2xl max-w-5xl mx-auto

elements: Destination hero photo thumbnail with gradient overlay
Operator avatar + name + Passport-stamp Verified badge
Price: Listed price vs TRUE PRICE (includes flight/taxis/food) with hover popover breakdown
Seats left visual bar (e.g. '3 seats left at this price')
Fit chip (e.g. '98% Match for Solo Backpackers')
Heart bookmark button with burst animation
Compare checkbox (adds trip to sticky compare tray)

compare_tray.description: Sticky bottom dock showing up to 4 selected trips with quick removal, clear all, and 'Compare Side-by-Side' action button.
compare_tray.container_class: fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 w-[92%] max-w-4xl bg-[#0B1F2A] text-white p-3 sm:p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border border-teal-800

itinerary_timeline.description: Scroll-drawn vertical line connecting daily timeline cards (Day 1 to Day N) with expandable activity details, meals included badge, stay location pin.

filter_rail_mobile_bottom_sheet.description: Desktop side rail / Mobile bottom sheet (Shadcn Sheet) with counts for price range, duration, vibe, Indian operator filter, flight inclusion toggle, and sticky 'Show N Trips' button.

data_testid_conventions.rule: Mandatory kebab-case testids on all interactive elements & key figures

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes.
Implement the compact hero search bar with glassmorphism and smooth responsive collapse.
Use ticket-stub styling for search result cards with perforated inner cutouts.
Support dark and light modes cleanly using Tailwind dark: classes and CSS root variables.
Verify sticky Compare Dock appears smoothly when 1 to 4 trips are checked.
Add Framer Motion animations for staggered card reveals, tab switching, and heart bursts.
